_doc: Commander America RPG battle sprite roster: every fighter, enemy and boss mapped to a sprite, with briefs for the artist. Source of truth for enemies.json spriteId and sprites.json; brief and apply with ../voice-rpg-engine/scripts/sprite_roster.py commander-america-rpg [--apply]. Spec: ../voice-rpg-engine/docs/SPRITE_PLAN.md.
title: Commander America RPG
summary: A political parody JRPG: public figures as a JRPG party, their famous gaffes and props as spells, and the bosses mostly earlier or rival versions of the party. Draw everyone as affectionate 16-bit caricatures that match the portraits in `app/src/main/assets/portraits/` (big recognisable hair, signature suits and props); the satire is in the props and poses, never in mocking anyone's body, ethnicity or religion. The regular enemies are mostly animated objects and media types (potted ferns, freezers, teleprompters, a riding mower) and should be as funny as their names.
style_extra: Bright, saturated palette like the portraits (navy suits, red ties, gold, neon studio light); one oversized signature prop per character, readable at 64 px.
Every party member is also fought as a boss or enemy in another storyline, so each party sheet carries the boss tags too (windup, charge_ultimate, ultimate, death).

party.name: Commander America
party.look: From portraits/commander_america.jpg: swept golden hair, navy suit, long red tie, flag pin, an orange tan; a golden escalator brawler. Signature prop: a black Sharpie and a can of Diet Coke.
party.moves: charge: accordion hands, pumping; cast: points with both index fingers, gold sparks (release=4); attack: a two-handed 'You're fired' chop; ko: topples backward stiffly; victory: double thumbs-up and a fist pump.

boss_versions.costume: 2016 version: the same suit, a red campaign cap
holding a weather map with a hand-drawn Sharpie bubble
the mugshot glare: a scowl, a booking-photo flash behind (a separate sheet with the pose is worth it)
debate podium version, holding a blank sheet ('concepts of a plan')
a fry-cook apron over the shirt and tie, a fry basket; or the neon-orange vest (costume change: own sheet recommended)
the finale: behind a golden podium, gold trim on the suit (own 96 px sheet recommended)

party.name: Hill-Rod
party.look: A pantsuit politician (portraits/template/hill_rod_template.jpg): blonde bob, a bright pantsuit, a smartphone in each hand, a basement server rack's blue glow; the Chappaqua server technomancer. Props: a cloth wipe and a bottle of hot sauce from her purse.
party.moves: cast: wipes the air with a cloth and data dissolves (release=4); attack: hot-sauce splash; victory: a wave to the crowd.

boss_versions.costume: Server Sovereign: a blue server-light aura

party.name: Joe Naptime
party.look: From portraits/biden.jpg: white hair, aviator sunglasses, a navy suit, an ice-cream cone in hand; the Grand Ice-Cream Cryomancer.
party.moves: cast: lifts the cone and fires a frosty scoop (release=4); attack: an aviators-on finger point; idle: a gentle doze-and-wake; ko: nods off standing.

boss_versions.costume: a double-scoop chocolate-chip waffle cone, a teleprompter behind
the same with a two-scoop waffle cone

party.name: Kamala Coconut
party.look: From portraits/kamala.jpg: shoulder-length dark wavy hair, a pearl necklace, a bright suit, glowing overlapping Venn-diagram rings floating at her hands, a big laugh.
party.moves: cast: throws Venn rings that overlap and pulse (release=4); attack: a yellow school-bus charge (a little bus sprite); victory: laughs, rings spinning.

boss_versions.costume: 3-Circle Venn: three rings orbiting
Kamala the Unburdened (a regular enemy): the rings looping endlessly, a dreamy glow

party.name: Kash Subpoena
party.look: From portraits/kash.jpg: short dark hair, trimmed beard, a dark suit, a red book titled like a children's tale held up like a spellbook (no readable text), a declassified folder.
party.moves: cast: opens the book and pages fly out as bolts (release=4); attack: slams the folder; charge: reads aloud, glowing.

boss_versions.costume: Wizard Kash: a purple wizard hat and a 4-page FISA scroll
the $19.99 King Book held high, a price tag

party.name: Foghorn Kennedy
party.look: From portraits/kennedy.jpg: silver hair, reading glasses on the nose, a tan seersucker suit, a yellow legal pad and a fountain pen; folksy country-fried cross-examiner.
party.moves: cast: peers over the glasses and a folksy one-liner blasts out as a shockwave (release=4); attack: jabs with the pen; victory: hooks thumbs in his lapels.

boss_versions.costume: Oxford drawl: an Oxford scarf
the same, at a hearing-room desk

party.name: Little Marco
party.look: From portraits/marco.jpg: neat dark hair, a navy suit and blue tie, an emergency water bottle; a slight, earnest Sanctions Sorcerer.
party.moves: cast: takes a sip and sprays a sanctions scroll (release=4); attack: hurls the water bottle; charge: sips nervously.

party.name: Mayor Swagger
party.look: From portraits/mayor_swagger.jpg: bald, a big grin, a royal-blue suit with a gold-striped tie, a gold VIP card and a nightlife-czar swagger.
party.moves: cast: flicks the VIP card like a throwing star (release=4); attack: a shoulder-shimmy bump; victory: pops champagne (sparkling water).

boss_versions.costume: Istanbul Envoy: a Turkish Airlines amenity kit and eye mask on the forehead

party.name: Nancy Palooza
party.look: From portraits/pelosi.jpg: voluminous brown hair, a hot-pink suit, an orange pearl necklace, a gavel, and a pint of premium ice cream; Sub-Zero Call-Option Oracle with a stock chart glowing behind.
party.moves: cast: the sideways seal clap, a ripple of light (release=4); attack: gavel strike; ultimate (boss): two Sub-Zero freezers open and blast frost.

boss_versions.costume: Sub-Zero Oracle: frost on the suit, a speech torn in half

party.name: JD Pants
party.look: From portraits/vance.jpg: full beard, swept dark hair, a navy suit and tie, a bakery box of donuts ('whatever makes sense').
party.moves: cast: hurls a sprinkle donut like a discus (release=4); attack: box-shove; idle: peers into the box.

boss_versions.costume: Donut Interrogator: leaning over a counter
'Whatever Makes Sense': arms spread
Diet Mountain Dew (a regular enemy): a green soda can in hand

party.name: Zohran Cardamom
party.look: From portraits/mamdani.jpg: tousled dark hair, short beard, a red hoodie under a denim jacket, a rolled chapati in hand, a transit map behind him; the fare-free chapati rap mayor.
party.moves: cast: flips a sizzling chapati like a frisbee (release=4); attack: a mic-drop shockwave; victory: rap pose.

boss_versions.costume: 'Mr. Cardamom': a food-truck spatula, spices swirling

families.name: Rally Cut-Out
families.look: A life-size cardboard cut-out of a generic rally heckler on a wooden A-frame stand (no real person): a painted-on scowl, a megaphone, a blank protest sign. Used by the voice tutorial.
families.moves: attack: wobbles forward on its stand; hurt: flaps backward; death: folds flat and topples.

families.name: Cable News Producer
families.look: A frazzled cable news producer: headset, rolled-up sleeves, a clipboard and a stopwatch, a 'LIVE' tally light on the shoulder (no text).
families.moves: attack: Aimed Shot, flings the clipboard; cast: the tally light flashes like a camera strobe.

members.variant: Hostile Fisheye Fact-Checker: big fisheye glasses, red stamp in hand

families.name: K-Street Lobbyist
families.look: A slick lobbyist in a charcoal pinstripe suit, slicked hair, a briefcase overflowing with cash and talking points.
families.moves: attack: swings the briefcase; cast: tosses a fan of cash like throwing cards.

members.variant: Super PAC strategist: rolled sleeves, focus-group charts
Consultant fact-checker: grey cardigan, red pen
DealBook executive: a lanyard and a tablet

families.name: Low-Flow Regulator
families.look: A municipal inspector: short-sleeve dress shirt, pocket protector, clipboard, a toilet plunger holstered like a sword.
families.moves: attack: plunger thrust; cast: writes a ticket that flies out.

members.variant: Brooklyn rat inspector: a hard hat and a rat trap
bus fare inspector: transit uniform and cap
Redaction sentinel: a navy windbreaker and a giant black marker

families.name: Poupon Mustard Sommelier
families.look: A tuxedoed waiter with a towel over the arm, presenting a jar of Dijon mustard on a silver tray like a fine wine.
families.moves: cast: pops the jar and fires a mustard bolt (release=4); attack: tray swipe.

families.name: Chappaqua Basement Server Rack
families.look: A basement server rack on stubby legs, blinking blue and green lights, cables like dreadlocks, a cloth wipe hanging from it.
families.moves: attack: Iron Slam with a drive-bay arm; cast: blinks and sprays data bits.

families.name: Hostile Studio Fern
families.look: A potted fern from a talk-show set that walks on its pot, fronds lashing like arms, a little scowl among the leaves.
families.moves: attack: frond whip; cast: shakes and sheds a volley of leaves.

members.variant: Potted Fern Intern: a tiny lanyard, a lighter green

families.name: Billy Access-Bus Hot Mic
families.look: From portraits/billy_bus.jpg: spiky blond hair, leather jacket over a band tee, a VIP lanyard and a headset hot mic.
families.moves: cast: taps the hot mic and a feedback wave shoots out (release=4); attack: a cheesy finger-gun.

families.name: $50 Casting Extra
families.look: A paid crowd extra in a campaign T-shirt and ball cap, waving a sign on a stick (blank sign, no text).
families.moves: attack: bonks with the sign; cast: cheers, a wave of confetti.

members.variant: South Philly heckler: kelly-green team jacket, a cheesesteak

families.name: Sub-Zero Freezer Golem
families.look: A stainless designer freezer come alive, doors as a mouth, frost breath, ice-cream pints for fists.
families.moves: attack: slams a pint fist; cast: doors swing open in a frost blast.

members.variant: a double scoop of chocolate chip on its head

families.name: eSalon Blowout Stylist
families.look: A celebrity hairstylist with a huge blowout, a hair dryer drawn like a pistol and a round brush in the other hand.
families.moves: attack and cast: fires a hot-air blast from the dryer (release=4).

families.name: The 11-Day Mooch
families.look: From portraits/mooch.jpg: slicked black hair, sunglasses on the head, a navy pinstripe suit, a little tornado spinning around his feet.
families.moves: attack: spins into a whirlwind dash; cast: the tornado grows and flings papers.

families.name: Merch Box Golem
families.look: A golem of stacked cardboard merchandise boxes, packing tape for joints, a box-flap mouth, packing peanuts spilling out.
families.moves: attack: box-stack slam; cast: fires packing peanuts.

members.variant: bankers boxes with a small gilded chandelier on top
a pink bakery box with sprinkles
a giant three-ring binder version, pop-quiz pages flapping

families.name: Four Seasons Riding Mower
families.look: A green riding lawn mower with no rider, headlights for eyes, the cutter deck grinning, grass clippings spraying.
families.moves: attack: charges forward; cast: sprays clippings.

families.name: Toe-Cage Trek Bicycle
families.look: A stationary beach bicycle on a stand with metal pedal toe-cages snapping like jaws, the handlebars as horns.
families.moves: attack: the pedals spin and snap; cast: rings its bell (a shockwave).

members.variant: rustier, a single giant toe-cage pedal for a head

families.name: 1967 Corvette Sentinel
families.look: A classic 1967 Corvette Stingray in green with headlight eyes popping up, guarding a garage, exhaust puffing.
families.moves: attack: revs and rams; cast: headlights flash.

families.name: Teleprompter
families.look: A glass teleprompter on a stand, scrolling glowing lines (no readable text), a little face reflected in the glass.
families.moves: cast: the scroll fires a beam of lines (release=4); attack: tips forward.

members.variant: an old CRT television on legs instead of the glass (own sheet would sell it better)

families.name: 'Never Surrender' Mug Press
families.look: A mug-printing press machine stamping out mugs with a glaring face printed on them (no readable text), mugs piling up.
families.moves: attack: stamps down; cast: fires mugs.

families.name: Neon-Orange Garbage Truck
families.look: A white garbage truck with a neon-orange safety vest stripe, the hopper as a mouth, rolling on chunky tyres.
families.moves: attack: hopper chomp; cast: honks (shockwave).

families.name: Turkish Airlines Lie-Flat Pod
families.look: A first-class airline lie-flat seat pod come alive, the seat back flapping like a mouth, a tray table arm, a little amenity kit.
families.moves: attack: reclines suddenly into you; cast: fires warm towels.

families.name: Porcelain Basin
families.look: A white porcelain bathroom sink on a pedestal, faucet as a nose, spraying water, the drain an eye.
families.moves: attack: lunges; cast: sprays water.

families.name: Diet Coke Valet Turret
families.look: A red wooden desk box with a single big button on top, a small turret barrel that pops out to fire soda cans.
families.moves: cast: the button is pressed and a can fires (release=4); attack: the lid snaps.

families.name: Federal Green Mandate Drone
families.look: A quadcopter drone painted green with a leaf emblem and a dangling charging cable like a tail. Hovers; its shadow marks the floor.
families.moves: attack: dives; cast: zaps with the charging cable.

families.name: Venn Loop
families.look: A living glowing ring (one circle of a Venn diagram) rolling and pulsing, overlapping its own afterimage.
families.moves: attack: rolls through; cast: pulses outward.

bosses.name: Low-Energy Dynasty Candidate
bosses.look: From portraits/jeb.jpg: glasses, a tan button-down, a bowl of guacamole held up; a gentle, deflated stance.
bosses.moves: attack: a polite podium shove; cast: holds up the guacamole and asks the crowd to clap (a sad wave); ultimate: a campaign-fund money rain.

bosses.name: Barry Teleprompter (Tan Suit)
bosses.look: From portraits/obama.jpg: short grey hair, the famous tan summer suit, a microphone in one hand and a Dijon burger in the other.
bosses.moves: attack: the mic drop (a shockwave); cast: teleprompter beams; ultimate: a giant mic falls from above.

bosses.name: Zach Two-Ferns
bosses.look: From portraits/zach_ferns.jpg: shaggy hair and beard, a corduroy jacket, two potted ferns flanking him as if they were bodyguards, cue cards in hand.
bosses.moves: attack: flicks a cue card; cast: the ferns lash; ultimate: an awkward silence that freezes the stage.

bosses.name: Cable News Aerial Spin Anchor
bosses.look: From portraits/media_anchor.jpg: a news anchor in glasses and a blue suit with a headset, a breaking-news chyron wrapped around him like a ribbon (no text), spinning on a camera crane.
bosses.moves: attack: swoops on the crane; cast: fires 'UNVERIFIED' stamps (blank stamps); ultimate: a spin cycle of headlines.

bosses.name: NOAA Cone-of-Uncertainty Chief
bosses.look: A meteorologist in a NOAA windbreaker before a hurricane map, a cone of uncertainty projected from a remote clicker.
bosses.moves: attack: clicker zap; cast: summons a little storm; ultimate: the cone of uncertainty sweeps the arena.

bosses.name: Spicy Sean (Neon Salsa Shirt)
bosses.look: From portraits/spicy_sean.jpg: a press secretary bursting out of the hedges in a neon-green ruffled dance shirt, chewing gum, a podium on wheels.
bosses.moves: attack: salsa spin kick; cast: shoots gum; ultimate: a full dance-floor spotlight number.

bosses.name: Rudy Ghoul (Melting Hair Dye)
bosses.look: From portraits/rudy_ghoul.jpg: a ghoulish lawyer in a navy suit, hair dye dripping down both cheeks, a briefcase of 'evidence', a cold-open courtroom glare.
bosses.moves: attack: briefcase slam; cast: shouts an objection that bursts out as a dark wave; ultimate: drips of dye swirl into a storm.

bosses.name: Air Force One Triple-Stumble Staircase
bosses.look: The rolling airstairs of a presidential jet come alive, steps as teeth, the handrails as arms, wind gusts swirling around it.
bosses.moves: attack: the steps fold and snap; cast: a gust of wind; ultimate: a triple stumble shockwave.

bosses.name: Bathroom Chandelier Box Inspector
bosses.look: A subpoena archivist in a navy windbreaker with a magnifying glass, standing on stacked bankers boxes under a gilded chandelier.
bosses.moves: attack: slams a box lid; cast: the magnifier focuses a beam; ultimate: the boxes topple in an avalanche.

bosses.name: Corn Pop (Rusty Rain-Barrel Dude)
bosses.look: A 1960s swimming-pool tough from the old anecdote: slicked pompadour, sleeveless tee, a rusty chain, a dented rain barrel beside him (no ethnicity cues: the gag is the barrel and the chain).
bosses.moves: attack: swings the chain; cast: kicks the barrel and rusty water sprays; ultimate: barrel-roll charge.

bosses.name: Chief Bureau Archivist
bosses.look: From portraits/comey.jpg: a very tall man in a navy suit, a stack of memos under one arm and a shredder-ghost hovering behind him.
bosses.moves: attack: memo slap; cast: shredded strips fly; ultimate: the archive phantoms rise.

bosses.name: 'Whatever Makes Sense' Glazed Case
bosses.look: An unimpressed bakery display case on legs, rows of donuts as teeth, a sliding glass door mouth.
bosses.moves: attack: the door slams; cast: fires glazed donuts; ultimate: the whole case empties in a donut storm.

bosses.name: Uncontextualized Pundit
bosses.look: A pundit at a news desk with a bowl of literal word salad (lettuce with letter shapes, no readable words), tossing it angrily.
bosses.moves: attack: flings salad; cast: the desk monitors flash; ultimate: a salad tornado.

bosses.name: Shattered Armor-Glass Cybertruck
bosses.look: An angular stainless-steel electric pickup come alive, its 'armor glass' windows spidered with cracks, headlight bar as a single glowing eye.
bosses.moves: attack: rams; cast: the window glass shatters outward; ultimate: full-throttle charge.

bosses.name: 4,000-Page Omnibus Pork Golem
bosses.look: A towering golem of stacked bill pages bound with red tape, pork chops and earmark tags sticking out, a gavel fist.
bosses.moves: attack: gavel fist; cast: pages blast out; ultimate: the whole bill collapses onto the arena.

bosses.name: Luxury Condo Rent-Hike Lobbyist
bosses.look: A real-estate lobbyist in a camel overcoat with a tiny condo tower model under one arm and a rent-increase notice (blank) like a fan.
bosses.moves: attack: swats with the notice; cast: the condo model grows and shoots up; ultimate: a skyline of condos rises.

bosses.name: 6-Digit iPhone Passcode Cracker
bosses.look: A hooded forensic hacker with a laptop and a phone on a cable, glowing keypad digits floating around (no readable digits needed).
bosses.moves: attack: cable whip; cast: a burst of digits; ultimate: the phone unlocks in a flash.

bosses.name: Musk-X (Mid-Air 'X' Star-Jump)
bosses.look: From portraits/elon.jpg: dark hair, black X T-shirt and jacket, mid-air in an X-shaped star jump, carrying a porcelain bathroom sink.
bosses.moves: attack: hurls the sink; cast: star-jump shockwave; ultimate: launches like a rocket.

bosses.name: Musk-X (Dark Gothic Star-Jump)
bosses.look: The finale version: an all-black gothic outfit and black cap; a darker recolour of the star-jump sheet.

bosses.name: Stranded EV Battery Golem
bosses.look: A hulking golem of stacked EV battery packs, charging cables as dangling arms, a dim low-battery glow in its chest.
bosses.moves: attack: cable whip; cast: siphons a stream of energy; ultimate: a power surge that drains the party.

notes: Boss versions of party members are recolours of the party sheet by default; draw a sheet named after the boss id where the costume changes (fry apron, golden podium, mugshot, wizard hat).
Enemies have no family/selfElement in the data; the brief can't show elements for this game.
